column1: # ADR-0050 D8: the placement replay corpus — one row per measured arm of a site: the part, the site's extents and
# formats (f32: f32 storage, an f32 product; tf32: f32 storage admitting TF32; bf16: both operands stored bf16, the
# product bf16 | f32; bf16w: b stored bf16, a f32, the product bf16 | f32), the emission's order, the arm's name and
# its schedule as a plan string, its time (us, or relative units within one id), the null, `rules` on the arm the
# shipped rules pick, the box's properties beyond the part's profile (`program=<stem>`: the measured program of
# benches/algorithms, whose `residence_plan` gives the site's warm operands), and the source. Plans: `mma:<fmt>:<mt>.<nt>.<wy>
# warp tensor tile), or `rules[:+rung,-rung]` (the emitter's launch now under those arms — the arm as measured where
# the emitter has not drifted since; `crates/backends/llvm/src/place.rs` test `place_replay_scores`). Seeded from
# WALK_ARMS (17), mma_cut_replay (21), k-fill / streamk-fill, C11 l2-gate, wgmma-ws, plan-cost's losers, mma-depth
# and split-tile (rung_replay.tsv's lines); `hyb-*` (ADR-0050 C5): the rules' 16-bit tile ordered, walked and hybrid
# (`<trav>.h<h>`: the raster height) on the walk-arm shapes, ABBA on this RTX 5080.
